sentences.japanese: 私の息子は百まで数えられる。
sentences.english: My son can count up to a hundred now.

sentences.japanese: うちの息子は百まで数えられるんだ。
sentences.english: My son can count up to a hundred now.

sentences.japanese: すずめ百まで踊り忘れず。
sentences.english: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.

sentences.japanese: その道を百メートル程行くと、三叉路があります。
sentences.english: Go straight up the street for about 100 meters, and you will get to the junction of three roads.

sentences.japanese: その程度のことは百も承知だったから、私は少しも驚かなかった。
sentences.english: I was not in the least surprised, for I had fully expected as much.
